dialog.title: Share purchase (GmbH)
dialog.description: Purchase or sale of shares in a GmbH (German limited liability company). Notarial certification is required by law.
step.gesellschaft.title: Target company
field.firma.label: Company name of the GmbH

field.adresse_gesellschaft.helpText: If the business address and the registered seat are identical, activate the toggle – the values are kept in sync.
field.registergericht.label: Registry court
field.registergericht.helpText: The court where the GmbH is registered in the commercial register.
field.handelsregister_nr.label: Commercial register number (HRB)
field.stammkapital_waehrung.label: Currency of the share capital
field.stammkapital_waehrung.helpText: Default is EUR. For historical amounts in DM you can switch here.
field.stammkapital.label: Share capital (EUR)

field.stammkapital_dm.label: Share capital (DM)
field.stammkapital_eur_aus_dm.label: ≈ in Euro
field.ug_hinweis.label: Notice
field.ug_hinweis.text: The share capital entered is below €25,000. Could this be a UG (haftungsbeschränkt) rather than a GmbH? Please check the legal form.
field.stammkapital_voll_eingezahlt.label: Share capital fully paid in?
field.geschaeftsfuehrer.label: Current managing director(s)
field.gesellschafterliste_aktuell.label: Is a current list of shareholders available?
step.veraeusserer.title: Seller (transferor)
field.anzahl_veraeusserer.label: Number of sellers
field.veraeusserer.label: Seller
field.veraeusserer.field.anteil_nennbetr: Nominal amount according to the list of shareholders.
field.veraeusserer.field.hinweis_nennbet: The nominal amount of the share exceeds the total share capital. Please check the entries.
field.veraeusserer.field.verkauft_komple: Is the share sold in full or in part?
field.veraeusserer.field.verkaufter_teil: Amount of the partial share sold (EUR)
Nominal amount of the part sold, if not the entire share is transferred.

field.anzahl_erwerber.label: Number of buyers
field.erwerber.label: Buyer
field.erwerber.field.familienstand.label: Marital status
field.erwerber.field.dolmetscher.label: Interpreter required?
step.kaufbedingungen.title: Purchase terms
field.kaufpreis.label: Purchase price (EUR)
field.kaufpreis_aufteilung.label: Allocation of the purchase price (for multiple sellers)
field.zahlungsziel.label: Payment date
field.zahlungsweise.label: Payment method
field.zahlungsweise.helpText: A notary escrow account offers additional security for both sides.
field.bankverbindung_info.label: IBAN of the recipient (optional)
field.vollzugsbedingungen.label: Completion / closing conditions
field.vollzugsbedingungen.placeholder: e.g. antitrust clearance, consent of co-shareholders
field.vollzugsbedingungen.helpText: Conditions to be met before the transfer takes effect.

field.stichtag.label: Economic transfer date

field.gf_wechsel.label: Change of management?
field.gf_abberufen.label: Managing directors to be removed

field.satzungsaenderung.label: Amendment of the articles of association required?

field.haftungsausschluss.label: Limitations / exclusions of liability?
field.haftungsausschluss_info.label: Details on liability limitations

field.steuerklauseln.helpText: Provisions for taxes that economically arose before the transfer date.
